description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'PermissionsApiResource' for managing application permissions within the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to list permissions and update permissions related to Maker Checker functionality, including handling security, serialization, and command processing.

classes.name: PermissionsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class providing endpoints to retrieve and update application permissions, with support for maker-checker permissions and integration with Fineract's security and serialization infrastructure.

methods.name: retrieveAllPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all permissions, optionally filtering for maker-checker permissions based on query parameters.

methods.name: updatePermissionsDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to enable or disable permissions related to Maker Checker functionality by processing JSON payloads.
